projects.title: Hotel bookings. One connected system.
projects.name: Aureum Stays
projects.imageAlt: Aureum Stays home page with the destination, stay type, dates and guest search.
projects.summary: My full-stack hotel booking system, connecting the guest journey with room availability, payments and the staff tools behind each stay.
projects.problem: Guests and staff need room availability, pricing and reservation status to stay in sync.
projects.contribution: I built the whole project, from the guest interface and staff dashboard to the APIs, PostgreSQL data model, payments and email workflows.
projects.solution: A single Next.js application connects guest bookings and staff operations through PostgreSQL. Server-side services handle availability, permissions and payments; separate workers process booking holds and queued email.
features: English and Simplified Chinese property browsing with location, stay and guest filters.
Property galleries, room selection, availability and a booking review with nightly prices, fees and taxes.
Stripe payment integration with signed webhook handling and refund workflows.
Staff views for arrivals, departures, reservations, room status and date blocks.
Role-based access for customers, employees, team leads, managers and super admins.
Queued confirmation, cancellation and reminder emails, with operational history and worker status.

engineering.title: Availability follows the inventory
engineering.body: The server checks physical rooms, date blocks, confirmed reservations and active holds inside a serializable transaction, with idempotency keys for repeated requests.

engineering.title: Payments are confirmed on the server
engineering.body: Signed Stripe webhooks update reservation state after payment, with capacity checks and a refund path when a room change removes capacity.

engineering.title: Email runs in the background
engineering.body: Booking changes and notification jobs are saved together; a worker processes the outbox and retries temporary delivery failures.

engineering.title: Access follows staff responsibilities
engineering.body: Server-side permissions control booking, room, reporting and settings access, supported by operational history.

projects.outcome: An end-to-end hotel application connecting guest bookings, room inventory and staff operations.
projects.built: Guest bookings, room inventory & staff operations

projects.title: Final Year Project
projects.name: Final Year Project
projects.imageAlt: Original Trinity Medical Center Client home page with hospital services and appointment navigation.
projects.summary: A team-built hospital management system. My contribution focused on the Client module: helping patients find a doctor, book appointments, manage their account and communicate with doctors.
projects.problem: Patients need a clear path from finding a doctor to choosing an available appointment and managing their account.
projects.contribution: I developed the Client module: doctor discovery, appointment booking and management, patient profiles and patient–doctor messaging.
projects.solution: The team system uses ASP.NET Web Forms with C# page handlers and shared layouts. My Client pages use ADO.NET to connect patient workflows to the shared SQL Server records.
features: Doctor search by branch, department and name, followed by appointment-slot selection.
Date and consultation-type filters for Walk-in and Online Consultation appointments.
Patient profile editing, appointment history and appointment changes.
Stored patient–doctor conversations with periodic message refresh.
A connected staff workspace for scheduling, appointments, records and prescriptions as part of the wider team project.

engineering.title: Booking around available slots
engineering.body: The Client flow narrows staff-maintained appointment slots by branch, doctor, date and consultation type.

engineering.title: Shared Web Forms layouts
engineering.body: A shared master page provides navigation and layout, with C# page handlers and JavaScript supporting patient interactions.

engineering.title: Connected SQL Server records
engineering.body: ADO.NET retrieves doctor, appointment, profile and conversation records shared with the staff modules.

engineering.title: Stored conversations
engineering.body: Chat sessions and messages are saved in SQL Server, with an UpdatePanel periodically retrieving conversation updates.
